answer: A new comer posts 40 tokens and signs a device proof before admission. Validator agents check the attestation against a public ocean of hashes at registration. If the check fails, the bond is slashed and the seat is voided. Each receipt emits an echo into the event log. At epoch close, auditors compare outputs to the glacier of prior commitments. A seat pays 3 tokens while the bond is 40, so every extra clone ends 37 down. The mechanism prevents duplicate claims through this loss.
